name: Avert Attack
body:
School abjuration; Level cleric/oracle 1, paladin 1, sorcerer/wizard 1

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Target one creature
Duration 1 round/level or until discharged
Saving Throw none (harmless); Spell Resistance no (harmless)

DESCRIPTION

You grant the subject a +5 deflection bonus to AC against the next attack that targets it. Whether the attack succeeds or not, the spell is triggered and the effect ends.
